blurb: Guests rent ski boats or jet skis to enjoy water skiing, wakeboarding, tubing, fishing, or cruising on the Tennessee River and Chickamauga Lake. The company provides safety briefings and equipment checks before rental. Rentals include safety gear and access to scenic waterways around Chattanooga, TN.
